stances.summary: Praises Waymo autonomous vehicles as miraculous achievement
stances.quote: I don't know how people can look at Waymo's safety data (or just ride in one) and not feel like we live in an age of miracles. The car! Drives! Itself! https://t.co/mzX11DsYDe

stances.summary: Notes tension between ambitious AI research and consumer expectations
stances.quote: There’s a fascinating tension between what AI labs are building (PhD-level agents that win math olympiads and refactor code bases) and what most people want out of AI (friendly helpers that are pretty smart and can do stuff and don’t get a personality transplant every 6 months).

stances.summary: Suggests market exists for downplaying AI capabilities and progress
stances.quote: I used to think the "fancy autocomplete" stuff was just goofy cope from NLP dead-enders, but maybe it's actually more calculated than that. There's clearly a market for people who want to be told that AI is a fad and that they don't need to worry about it.

stances.summary: Observes wealthy AI researchers skeptical of joining new AGI ventures
stances.quote: The problem with trying to buy your way into the AGI race in 2025 is that top-tier AI researchers 1) are already rich, 2) think we have like 1-4 years before superintelligence, and 3) don't want to spend those years building AI companions for Instagram

stances.summary: Predicts AI meeting apps will sell training data for job automation

stances.summary: Criticizes AI skeptics for ignoring current usable AI capabilities
stances.quote:
There is a strain of AI skepticism that is rooted in pretending like it’s still 2021 and nobody can actually use this stuff for themselves. 

It has survived for longer than I would have guessed!

stances.summary: Notes AI replacing engineering workforce rather than eliminating it
stances.quote: AI isn’t replacing engineers, it’s just allowing us to employ half as many of them. Got it.

Bottom line: the scale/timing of job loss is uncertain, but this is not just hype. Companies are really doing it.
